== Crystle evolution line ==

Temtem commonly counts levels gained after acquisition rather than only checking an absolute level. The label makes that distinction explicit.

<evolution direction="bottom-to-top" theme="default">

[node id="sherald" name="Sherald" link="Sherald"]
[node id="tortenite" name="Tortenite" link="Tortenite"]

crystle -> sherald [type="level" label="Gain 30 levels"]

</evolution>
